first_cohort.decision: Unconditional speculative conversion can be wasted when the sampler is already late and skips that prepared frame. Before preparing lookahead, resample the real media clock; only prepare if playing in the same epoch/cycle and the next frame is still future. Otherwise let advance choose the current timestamp without another speculative conversion. New unit assertion verifies that an already-due lookahead starts no preparation. This is a named correction, not a new workload or budget revision.
